name: What measurements do I need for a bathroom countertop replacement quote?

mainEntity.name: What measurements do I need for a bathroom countertop replacement quote?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Accurate measurements should include the vanity’s overall width and depth, wall-to-wall conditions, side clearances, existing top thickness, sink opening, faucet-hole spacing, backsplash dimensions, and any irregular wall angles. Photos of the cabinet interior and plumbing are also useful.

**Context:** The visible top may not be perfectly square, and walls can vary from one end to the other. A custom top must account for those conditions rather than relying only on a nominal vanity size.

**Key factors:**
- Measure more than once and record the smallest relevant dimension.
- Mark sink centerline and faucet-hole locations.
- Note whether the top meets a wall on one, two, or three sides.
- Identify exposed ends requiring a finished edge.

**Practical guidance:** Use measurements for preliminary budgeting, but allow the installer or fabricator to verify final dimensions before cutting. Do not remove the existing top until the replacement plan is confirmed.

Elite Remodeling & Design can incorporate field conditions into design development and construction planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Record vanity width and depth, wall clearances, top thickness, sink opening, faucet-hole spacing, backsplash dimensions, finished-edge locations, and plumbing photos. Use homeowner measurements for an early estimate only; final custom fabrication should follow verified field dimensions.
